description.value: For 1 minute, the first time each creature tries to target the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell, it attempts a Will save; a given attacker only ever makes this save once per casting. Critical Success the attacker acts freely. Success the attacker acts normally. Failure that one action is wasted. Critical Failure as failure, and the attacker is off-guard against the warded creature until the start of its own next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'that one action is wasted' clause on an ordinary Failure has no rule-element equivalent -- no schema hook exists for nullifying an arbitrary future action. The critical-failure Off-Guard grant (buildable, PAT-CONDITION-GRANT) has been added to system.rules; this flag covers only the unbuilt Failure-only clause.
